rows.label: Bigfoot
rows.description: large and hairy ape-like mythical creature purported to inhabit forests in North America
rows.hook: is a huge, hairy humanoid said to roam forests, known for giant footprint casts and grainy footage

rows.label: Loch Ness Monster
rows.hook: is a long-necked, humped water beast said to lurk in a deep lake, known for disputed photographs

rows.label: Chupacabra
rows.description: legendary creature; first purported sighting in Puerto Rico
rows.hook: is a legendary creature said to attack livestock, especially goats, and drain their blood

rows.label: Mothman
rows.description: a singular legendary creature based around West Virginia, United States
rows.hook: is a bird-like humanoid cryptid, possibly just misidentified sandhill cranes or herons

rows.label: Yeti
rows.description: ape-like creature purported to inhabit the Himalayan mountain range in Asia
rows.hook: is a large, hairy humanoid nicknamed the Abominable Snowman, said to haunt snowy peaks

rows.label: drop bear
rows.description: famous hoax in contemporary Australian folklore
rows.hook: is a tall-tale hoax of a vicious, carnivorous koala that pounces from trees onto tourists

rows.label: jackalope
rows.hook: is a rabbit sporting antelope horns, popularized by taxidermy mounts

rows.label: Mokele-mbembe
rows.description: water-dwelling entity that supposedly lives in the Congo River Basin

rows.label: bunyip
rows.hook: is a swamp-lurking creature of Aboriginal mythology said to haunt billabongs and waterholes

rows.label: Mongolian death worm
rows.description: legendary deadly cryptid of the Gobi desert
